ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows quadrilateral ABCD, with the vertices forming a tilted rhombus in the order A-B-C-D; A is at the upper left, B is at the upper right, C is at the lower right, and D is at the lower left. The figure also draws diagonals AC and DB, which intersect at point P, and there is a right angle mark. From the figure it can be seen that ∠ABC and ∠BCD are adjacent interior angles, and ∠DAB and ∠BCD are opposite angles. Reasoning: The problem gives m∠ABC = 2x - 7, m∠BCD = 2x + 3. A rhombus is a parallelogram, so adjacent interior angles are supplementary: (2x - 7) + (2x + 3) = 180. Simplifying gives 4x - 4 = 180, 4x = 184, x = 46. Therefore m∠BCD = 2(46) + 3 = 95. Opposite angles of a parallelogram are equal, so m∠DAB = m∠BCD = 95.

method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是四边形 ABCD，顶点按 A-B-C-D 的顺序围成一个倾斜的菱形；A 在左上，B 在右上，C 在右下，D 在左下。图中还画出了对角线 AC 和 DB，它们交于点 P，并有直角标记。由图可见，∠ABC 与 ∠BCD 是相邻内角，∠DAB 与 ∠BCD 是对角。推理：题目给出 m∠ABC = 2x - 7，m∠BCD = 2x + 3。菱形是平行四边形，所以相邻内角互补：(2x - 7) + (2x + 3) = 180。化简得 4x - 4 = 180，4x = 184，x = 46。因此 m∠BCD = 2(46) + 3 = 95。平行四边形对角相等，所以 m∠DAB = m∠BCD = 95。

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the diagram shows ABCD as a slanted rhombus with A top-left, B top-right, C bottom-right, and D bottom-left. From this, ∠ABC is at B, ∠BCD is at C, and ∠DAB is at A. From the text, use the given angle expressions. Since a rhombus has parallel opposite sides, AB ∥ CD, so the same-side interior angles along transversal BC satisfy m∠ABC + m∠BCD = 180. Thus (2x - 7) + (2x + 3) = 180, so x = 46. Instead of using opposite-angle equality, use AD ∥ BC with AB as a transversal: ∠DAB and ∠ABC are same-side interior angles, so they are supplementary. Therefore m∠DAB = 180 - m∠ABC = 180 - (2(46) - 7) = 180 - 85 = 95.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中 ABCD 是一个倾斜的菱形，A 在左上，B 在右上，C 在右下，D 在左下；图中还画出了对角线 AC 和 DB，它们交于 P，并有一个直角标记。由图中标注可知，∠ABC 在顶点 B，∠BCD 在顶点 C，∠DAB 在顶点 A。推理：题目给出 ABCD 是菱形，所以对边平行，AB ∥ CD 且 AD ∥ BC。因为 AB ∥ CD，BC 是截线，所以同旁内角 ∠ABC 和 ∠BCD 互补：m∠ABC + m∠BCD = 180。代入表达式得 (2x - 7) + (2x + 3) = 180，即 4x - 4 = 180，所以 x = 46。于是 m∠ABC = 2(46) - 7 = 85。再由 AD ∥ BC，AB 作截线，∠DAB 和 ∠ABC 是同旁内角，互补，所以 m∠DAB = 180 - 85 = 95。
